title: James Baird Co. v. Gimbel Bros., Inc.
shortTitle: James Baird Co. v. Gimbel Bros., Inc.
summary: The introductory note presents Learned Hand’s rejection of reliance-based irrevocability for this bargain offer.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The general contractor used a subcontractor’s bid; the subcontractor discovered error and revoked before acceptance. Hand treated § 90 as directed to a different category of promise and emphasized the possibility of obtaining protection before relying. Drennan confronts that reasoning and finds a subsidiary irrevocability assurance. The notebook records the disagreement rather than harmonizing away the different results.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 252–253. Open assigned page 252.
